# Global Innovator Awards 2026

> The UK's first awards programme recognising founders, innovators, researchers and exceptional talent who came to the UK under an innovation or talent visa route and are delivering on their ambition. Independently judged, ten competitive categories plus the inaugural Pioneer Award. The 2026 winners were announced on 16 November 2026 at The Dorchester, London. Organised by NEXUS Creative HQ Ltd.

## Pages
- [Home](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/): Overview, the 2026 winners, partners, highlights and how to register for 2027.
- [Winners 2026](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/winners2026): The winner and Highly Commended in every category, plus the inaugural Pioneer Award.
- [Finalists](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/finalists): The 100 finalists of 2026, across ten categories.
- [Categories](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/categories): The 10 competitive categories plus the Pioneer Award, with descriptions and judging criteria.
- [About](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/about): Why the awards were created, who can apply, the two-stage process, and about NEXUS.
- [Get Involved](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/get-involved): Register interest in 2027 as talent, or as a partner or sponsor.
- [FAQs](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/faqs): Eligibility, entry, judging, confidentiality and contact.
- [Contact](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/contact): Enquiry form for sponsorship, partnerships, press and general questions.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/terms)
- [Privacy and Cookies](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/privacy)

## Key facts
- Organiser: NEXUS Creative HQ Ltd, trading as NEXUS (company no. 12667243).
- Eligibility: Founders, innovators and talent who came to the UK on a Global Talent Visa, Innovator Founder Visa, Graduate Visa, Innovator Visa (closed 2023), Start-up Visa, Tier 1 Exceptional Talent or Tier 1 Entrepreneur route.
- 2026 awards evening: 16 November 2026, The Dorchester, London. Winners: https://globalinnovatorawards.com/winners2026
- 2027: The awards return in 2027. Dates are to be confirmed; register interest at https://globalinnovatorawards.com/get-involved
